``` {r GlobalVars}

## ============================================================
## 1) Global settings for OM/EM dimensions and MSE horizon
## ============================================================

n_stocks      <- 1L
n_regions     <- 1L
n_ages        <- 6L
n_indices     <- 3L
n_fleets      <- 1L
n_seasons     <- 1L

year_start    <- 1973L                                          # first assessment year in data
year_end      <- 2022L                                          # last assessment year in data (50 yrs total)
MSE_years     <- 50L                                             # projection/feedback years for MSE
n_proj_years  <- (year_end - year_start + 1L) + MSE_years       # If 6 yr MSE: 50 + 6 = 56, but Ecov uses lag year so 57 rows later

base.years    <- year_start:year_end                             # c(1973,...,2022)
assess.interval <- 3L                                            # assess every 3 yrs
assess.years  <- seq(tail(base.years,1), year_end + MSE_years - assess.interval, by = assess.interval)

### OM_ECOV
## 7.1 Base Ecov list (template)
ecov_om <- list(
  label = "bt_temp",
  mean  = as.matrix(c(env.dat_me$bt_temp, rep(NA_real_, 51))),   # fill future later
  logsigma = "est_1",
  year  = 1972:2072,                                            # includes 1-lag year (1972) + 1973–2028
  use_obs = matrix(1, ncol = 1, nrow = 101),                     # observed everywhere (we may override in MSE)
  process_model = "ar1",
  recruitment_how = matrix("controlling-lag-1-linear")
)

```

```{r OMBio}
## ============================================================
## 2) Build user-defined biology (maturity, WAA) over base+MSE
##    - Copy first 50 years from fitted OM, hold constant after
## ============================================================

## 2.1 Maturity-at-age array: [stock, year, age]
user_maturity <- array(NA_real_, dim = c(n_stocks, n_proj_years, n_ages))

## copy years 1:50 from the fitted OM (which has 50 base years)
user_maturity[, 1:50, ] <- om_ecov$input$data$mature[, 1:50, ]

## hold the last historical year (50) constant into projection years (51:56)
for (iy in 51:n_proj_years) {
  user_maturity[, iy, ] <- om_ecov$input$data$mature[, 50, , drop = FALSE]
}

## 2.2 Weight-at-age list structure expected by WHAM
user_waa <- list()
user_waa$waa <- array(NA_real_, dim = c(5, n_proj_years, n_ages))  # "5" is the WHAM WAA dimension slot (fleets/indices/SSB/M/etc.)

## copy historical 1:50
user_waa$waa[, 1:50, ] <- om_ecov$input$data$waa[, 1:50, ]

## extend to 51:56 by last historical year
for (iy in 51:n_proj_years) {
  user_waa$waa[, iy, ] <- om_ecov$input$data$waa[, 50, , drop = FALSE]
}

## copy WAA pointer metadata directly from base OM
user_waa$waa_pointer_fleets  <- om_ecov$input$data$waa_pointer_fleets
user_waa$waa_pointer_indices <- om_ecov$input$data$waa_pointer_indices
user_waa$waa_pointer_totcatch<- om_ecov$input$data$waa_pointer_ssb
user_waa$waa_pointer_ssb     <- om_ecov$input$data$waa_pointer_ssb
user_waa$waa_pointer_M       <- om_ecov$input$data$waa_pointer_M

## Spawning fraction by year from ASAP (WHAM wants this)
fracyr_spawn <- gb_dat[[1]]$dat$fracyr_spawn

## ============================================================
## 3) Observation model specs for catch and indices
## ============================================================

catch_info <- list(
  catch_cv       = 0.05,   # CV for aggregated catch
  catch_Neff     = 50,     # Neff for catch-at-age
  use_agg_catch  = 1,      # use aggregated catch
  use_catch_paa  = 1       # use catch-at-age
)

index_info <- list(
  index_cv        = rep(0.5, n_indices),      # CV for aggregated indices
  index_Neff      = rep(25, n_indices),       # Neff for index-at-age
  fracyr_indices  = c(0.25, 0.75, 0.25),      # timing of surveys
  q               = c(2.110e-4, 2.247e-4, 2.683e-4),
  use_indices     = rep(1, n_indices),        # use aggregated indices
  use_index_paa   = rep(1, n_indices),        # use index-at-age
  units_indices   = rep(2, n_indices),        # biomass/abundance units flags (as in your prior code)
  units_index_paa = rep(2, n_indices)
)

## ============================================================
## 4) Basic model info scaffold (whamMSE helper creates a big list)
##    Note: we’re calling a single helper to avoid hand-crafting dozens of slots
## ============================================================

info <- whamMSE::generate_basic_info(
  n_stocks = n_stocks, n_regions = n_regions, n_indices = n_indices,
  n_fleets = n_fleets, n_seasons = n_seasons,
  base.years = year_start:year_end,
  n_feedback_years = MSE_years,
  n_ages = n_ages,
  catch_info = catch_info, index_info = index_info,
  user_waa = user_waa, user_maturity = user_maturity,
  fracyr_spawn = fracyr_spawn
)

basic_info      <- info$basic_info
catch_info_use  <- info$catch_info
index_info_use  <- info$index_info

## ============================================================
## 5) Fishing mortality initializer: copy historical Fbar(ages 2–5) from base OM
## ============================================================

F_info <- info$F
F_info$F[1:50, ] <- om_ecov$rep$Fbar[1:50, 1, drop = FALSE]    # copy the historical Fbar trajectory
## leave projection years for MSE to overwrite

## ============================================================
## 6) Selectivity, Natural mortality, and NAA process
## ============================================================

## 6.1 Selectivity set: 1 fleet + 3 indices (as in your earlier config)
sel3 <- list(
  model = c("age-specific", "logistic", "logistic", "logistic"),
  re    = c("ar1_y", "none", "none", "none"),
  initial_pars = list(
    c(0.017, 0.249, 0.751, 1, 1, 1),   # fleet age-specific (fix older ages below)
    c(2.305, 0.327),                    # index 1 logistic
    c(1.611, 0.483),                    # index 2 logistic
    c(2.135, 0.217)                     # index 3 logistic
  ),
  fix_pars = list(c(4:6), NULL, NULL, NULL) # fix ages 4–6 at 1 for fleet selectivity
)

## 6.2 M (constant by age, from your provided vector)
M <- list(
  model = "constant",
  initial_means = array(c(0.57, 0.33, 0.26, 0.23, 0.22, 0.22), dim = c(n_stocks, n_regions, n_ages))
)

## 6.3 NAA process structure (rec+1 with age-specific sigma)
sigma_vals <- array(0.5, dim = c(n_stocks, n_regions, n_ages))
sigma_vals[,,1]    <- 0.655
sigma_vals[,,2:6]  <- 0.720

NAA_re <- list(
  N1_model     = rep("age-specific-fe", n_stocks),
  sigma        = rep("rec+1", n_stocks),
  cor          = rep("iid", n_stocks),
  recruit_model = 3,                                 # BH-like
  recruit_pars  = list(c(exp(8.082), 1.018e-4)),     # (logR0, a BH slope-ish param you used)
  sigma_vals    = sigma_vals
)


```

```{r OM_ecov}
## RECONFIG DIMS HERE IF CHANGING MSE PERIOD

## ============================================================
## 7) Environmental covariate (Ecov) series construction
##    - years 1972–2028 (= 57 rows) with a 1-year lag
##    - we will build a PROJECTED trend scenario for 2023–2028
## ============================================================

## MED PROJECTION
lm_fit <- lm(bt_temp ~ Year, data = env.dat_me)
lm_sum <- summary(lm_fit)
proj_df <- data.frame(year_proj = 2022:2072)                    # we only need 2023–2028, but harmless to compute 2022 too
error_sd <- lm_sum[["sigma"]] # residual SD
set.seed(42)
proj_df$SD <- rnorm(nrow(proj_df), 0, error_sd)
proj_df$Temp_proj <- lm_sum$coefficients[1,1] +
  lm_sum$coefficients[2,1]*proj_df$year_proj +
  proj_df$SD

proj_LOW <- proj_df
proj_LOW$Temp_proj <- env.dat_me[50,2] + #lm_sum$coefficients[1,1] +
  (-2*lm_sum$coefficients[2,1]*(proj_df$year_proj - 2021)) +
  proj_df$SD

proj_MEDLOW <- proj_df
proj_MEDLOW$Temp_proj <- env.dat_me[50,2] + #lm_sum$coefficients[1,1] +
  (-lm_sum$coefficients[2,1]*(proj_df$year_proj - 2021)) +
  proj_df$SD

proj_MED <- proj_df
proj_MED$Temp_proj <- env.dat_me[50,2] + #lm_sum$coefficients[1,1] +
  lm_sum$coefficients[2,1]*(proj_df$year_proj - 2021) +
  proj_df$SD

proj_HIGH <- proj_df
proj_HIGH$Temp_proj <- env.dat_me[50,2] + #lm_sum$coefficients[1,1] +
  (2*lm_sum$coefficients[2,1]*(proj_df$year_proj - 2021)) +
  proj_df$SD

## 7.3 Fill PROJECTED mean into 2023–2028 (rows 52:57 if year starts at 1972)
ecov_om_1 <- ecov_om
ecov_om_1$mean[51:101, 1] <- proj_LOW$Temp_proj[proj_df$year_proj >= 2022]  # 51->2022, 52->2023, ..., 57->2028

ecov_om_2 <- ecov_om
ecov_om_2$mean[51:101, 1] <- proj_MEDLOW$Temp_proj[proj_df$year_proj >= 2022]  # 51->2022, 52->2023, ..., 57->202

ecov_om_3 <- ecov_om
ecov_om_3$mean[51:101, 1] <- proj_MED$Temp_proj[proj_df$year_proj >= 2022]  # 51->2022, 52->2023, ..., 57->202

ecov_om_4 <- ecov_om
ecov_om_4$mean[51:101, 1] <- proj_HIGH$Temp_proj[proj_df$year_proj >= 2022]  # 51->2022, 52->2023, ..., 57->202

plotData <- data.frame(year = ecov_om$year,
                       OM_1 = ecov_om_1$mean,
                       OM_2 = ecov_om_2$mean,
                       OM_3 = ecov_om_3$mean,
                       OM_4 = ecov_om_4$mean
                       )

ggplot(plotData, aes(x = year, y = OM_1)) +
  #geom_point(aes(x = year, y = OM_1, color = 'blue')) +
  geom_line(aes(x = year, y = OM_1, color = 'blue')) +
  #geom_point(aes(x = year, y = OM_2, color = 'green')) +
  geom_line(aes(x = year, y = OM_2, color = 'green')) +
  #geom_point(aes(x = year, y = OM_3, color = 'black')) +
  geom_line(aes(x = year, y = OM_3, color = 'black')) +
  #geom_point(aes(x = year, y = OM_4, color = 'red')) +
  geom_line(aes(x = year, y = OM_4, color = 'red')) +
  xlim(2022,2072)

```

```{r OMReconfig_1}
## ============================================================
## 8) Build the WHAM OM input object using PROJECTED Ecov
##    - copy parameter guesses from fitted OM so it’s consistent
## ============================================================

om_input_1 <- wham::prepare_wham_input(
  basic_info  = basic_info,
  selectivity = sel3,
  M           = M,
  NAA_re      = NAA_re,
  ecov        = ecov_om_1,
  catch_info  = catch_info_use,
  index_info  = index_info_use,
  F           = F_info,
  age_comp    = "logistic-normal-pool0"
)

## 8.1 Ensure WAA is applied via whamMSE helper (same as earlier but inline)
waa_info <- info$par_inputs$user_waa
om_input_1 <- whamMSE::update_waa(om_input_1, waa_info = waa_info)

## 8.2 Copy parameter vectors from fitted OM for consistency
om_input_1$par$Ecov_process_pars <- om_ecov$parList$Ecov_process_pars
om_input_1$par$Ecov_beta_R       <- om_ecov$parList$Ecov_beta_R
om_input_1$par$catch_paa_pars    <- om_ecov$parList$catch_paa_pars
om_input_1$par$index_paa_pars    <- om_ecov$parList$index_paa_pars
om_input_1$par$sel_repars        <- om_ecov$parList$sel_repars

## 8.3 Initialize N1 for region i from base OM log_NAA (historical first-year)
for (i in 1:n_regions) {
  om_input_1$par$log_N1[i, i, ] <- log(om_ecov$rep$N1)[i, i, ] # IMPORTANT!!!
}
# om_ecov$rep$N1
## 8.4 Bring over historical index usage and sigma (rows 1:50) then extend flat
om_input_1$data$agg_index_sigma[1:50, ] <- input_hist$data$agg_index_sigma#[1:50, ] # CHANGED THESE LINES TO MATCH DIMS
om_input_1$data$use_indices[1:50, ]     <- input_hist$data$use_indices#[1:50, ]
om_input_1$data$use_index_paa[1:50, ]   <- input_hist$data$use_index_paa#[1:50, ]
for (iy in 51:n_proj_years) {
  om_input_1$data$agg_index_sigma[iy, ] <- input_hist$data$agg_index_sigma[50, ]
}

## 8.5 Compute remove-year matrices (zeros positions) for agg and paa (index)
##     We do it “inline” instead of a helper function.
loc_zeros_agg <- lapply(seq_len(ncol(input_hist$data$use_indices)), function(j)
  which(input_hist$data$use_indices[, j] == 0))
loc_zeros_paa <- lapply(seq_len(ncol(input_hist$data$use_index_paa)), function(j)
  which(input_hist$data$use_index_paa[, j] == 0))

max_agg <- max(sapply(loc_zeros_agg, length))
max_paa <- max(sapply(loc_zeros_paa, length))
remove_agg_years1 <- if (max_agg > 0) {
  out <- matrix(NA_integer_, nrow = max_agg, ncol = length(loc_zeros_agg))
  for (j in seq_along(loc_zeros_agg)) if (length(loc_zeros_agg[[j]])) out[1:length(loc_zeros_agg[[j]]), j] <- loc_zeros_agg[[j]]
  out
} else NULL
remove_paa_years1 <- if (max_paa > 0) {
  out <- matrix(NA_integer_, nrow = max_paa, ncol = length(loc_zeros_paa))
  for (j in seq_along(loc_zeros_paa)) if (length(loc_zeros_paa[[j]])) out[1:length(loc_zeros_paa[[j]]), j] <- loc_zeros_paa[[j]]
  out
} else NULL

## 8.6 Apply those removals to om_input_P
om_input_1 <- whamMSE::update_input_index_info(
  om_input_1,
  agg_index_sigma = om_input_1$data$agg_index_sigma,
  index_Neff      = om_input_1$data$index_Neff,
  remove_agg = TRUE, remove_agg_pointer = 1:3, remove_agg_years = remove_agg_years1,
  remove_paa = TRUE, remove_paa_pointer = 1:3, remove_paa_years = remove_paa_years1
)

## ============================================================
## 9) Fix Ecov random effects path for simulation:
##    - set historical Ecov_re (1:51) from fitted OM
##    - set future Ecov_re (52:57) = observed minus long-term mean (for projected)
##    - IMPORTANT: remove Ecov_re from random effects (TMB won’t re-simulate)
## ============================================================

## 9.1 Long-term mean (your explicit value)
long_term_bt_mean <- om_input_1[["par"]][["Ecov_process_pars"]][1]#7.341484

## 9.2 Populate Ecov_re into parameter list
## (length alignment: 1:51 is 1972–2022 when lag=1; 52:57 is 2023–2028)
om_input_1$par$Ecov_re[1:51, 1] <- Ecov_re[1:51, 1]             # from fitted OM/your saved RDS

## For PROJECTED scenario: future “random effect” = obs - process mean
om_input_1$par$Ecov_re[52:101, 1] <- om_input_1$data$Ecov_obs[52:101, 1] - long_term_bt_mean

## Tell WHAM to not simulate Ecov_re (use what we set)
om_input_1$data$do_simulate_Ecov_re <- 0L

## Remove "Ecov_re" from random effects so TMB won’t re-estimate/simulate it
if ("Ecov_re" %in% om_input_1$random) {
  om_input_1$random <- om_input_1$random[om_input_1$random != "Ecov_re"]
}

## ============================================================
## 10) Build UNFITTED OM object (TMB compiled), but do not fit
## ============================================================

unfitted_om_1 <- fit_wham(om_input_1, do.fit = FALSE, do.brps = FALSE, MakeADFun.silent = TRUE)

## Quick visual of Ecov obs vs latent x for this unfitted object
plot(unfitted_om_1$input$data$Ecov_obs, type = "l", col = "red",
     main = "PROJECTED scenario: Ecov obs vs latent",
     ylab = "Ecov", xlab = "row (1972..2028)")
lines(unfitted_om_1$rep$Ecov_x, type = "l", col = "blue")       # note: presence depends on model building; keep as per your script

## ============================================================
## 11) Simulate a concrete OM dataset from the unfitted OM
##     - We’ve removed Ecov_re from random list; keep others as-is
## ============================================================

random_1 <- unfitted_om_1$input$random
random_1 <- random_1[!random_1 %in% "Ecov_re"]                   # be explicit

set.seed(123 + 1L)
om_with_data_1 <- update_om_fn(unfitted_om_1, seed = 123 + 1L, random = random_1)

## Visual check again with simulated obs
plot(om_with_data_1$input$data$Ecov_obs, type = "l", col = "red",
     main = "Simulated OM: Ecov obs vs latent",
     ylab = "Ecov", xlab = "Year (1972..2072)")
lines(om_with_data_1$rep$Ecov_x, type = "l", col = "blue")

```

```{r OMReconfig_3}
## ============================================================
## 8) Build the WHAM OM input object using PROJECTED Ecov
##    - copy parameter guesses from fitted OM so it’s consistent
## ============================================================

om_input_3 <- wham::prepare_wham_input(
  basic_info  = basic_info,
  selectivity = sel3,
  M           = M,
  NAA_re      = NAA_re,
  ecov        = ecov_om_3,
  catch_info  = catch_info_use,
  index_info  = index_info_use,
  F           = F_info,
  age_comp    = "logistic-normal-pool0"
)

## 8.1 Ensure WAA is applied via whamMSE helper (same as earlier but inline)
waa_info <- info$par_inputs$user_waa
om_input_3 <- whamMSE::update_waa(om_input_3, waa_info = waa_info)

## 8.2 Copy parameter vectors from fitted OM for consistency
om_input_3$par$Ecov_process_pars <- om_ecov$parList$Ecov_process_pars
om_input_3$par$Ecov_beta_R       <- om_ecov$parList$Ecov_beta_R
om_input_3$par$catch_paa_pars    <- om_ecov$parList$catch_paa_pars
om_input_3$par$index_paa_pars    <- om_ecov$parList$index_paa_pars
om_input_3$par$sel_repars        <- om_ecov$parList$sel_repars

## 8.3 Initialize N1 for region i from base OM log_NAA (historical first-year)
for (i in 1:n_regions) {
  om_input_3$par$log_N1[i, i, ] <- log(om_ecov$rep$N1)[i, i, ] # IMPORTANT!!!
}
# om_ecov$rep$N1
## 8.4 Bring over historical index usage and sigma (rows 1:50) then extend flat
om_input_3$data$agg_index_sigma[1:50, ] <- input_hist$data$agg_index_sigma#[1:50, ] # CHANGED THESE LINES TO MATCH DIMS
om_input_3$data$use_indices[1:50, ]     <- input_hist$data$use_indices#[1:50, ]
om_input_3$data$use_index_paa[1:50, ]   <- input_hist$data$use_index_paa#[1:50, ]
for (iy in 51:n_proj_years) {
  om_input_3$data$agg_index_sigma[iy, ] <- input_hist$data$agg_index_sigma[50, ]
}

## 8.5 Compute remove-year matrices (zeros positions) for agg and paa (index)
##     We do it “inline” instead of a helper function.
loc_zeros_agg <- lapply(seq_len(ncol(input_hist$data$use_indices)), function(j)
  which(input_hist$data$use_indices[, j] == 0))
loc_zeros_paa <- lapply(seq_len(ncol(input_hist$data$use_index_paa)), function(j)
  which(input_hist$data$use_index_paa[, j] == 0))

max_agg <- max(sapply(loc_zeros_agg, length))
max_paa <- max(sapply(loc_zeros_paa, length))
remove_agg_years1 <- if (max_agg > 0) {
  out <- matrix(NA_integer_, nrow = max_agg, ncol = length(loc_zeros_agg))
  for (j in seq_along(loc_zeros_agg)) if (length(loc_zeros_agg[[j]])) out[1:length(loc_zeros_agg[[j]]), j] <- loc_zeros_agg[[j]]
  out
} else NULL
remove_paa_years1 <- if (max_paa > 0) {
  out <- matrix(NA_integer_, nrow = max_paa, ncol = length(loc_zeros_paa))
  for (j in seq_along(loc_zeros_paa)) if (length(loc_zeros_paa[[j]])) out[1:length(loc_zeros_paa[[j]]), j] <- loc_zeros_paa[[j]]
  out
} else NULL

## 8.6 Apply those removals to om_input_P
om_input_3 <- whamMSE::update_input_index_info(
  om_input_3,
  agg_index_sigma = om_input_3$data$agg_index_sigma,
  index_Neff      = om_input_3$data$index_Neff,
  remove_agg = TRUE, remove_agg_pointer = 1:3, remove_agg_years = remove_agg_years1,
  remove_paa = TRUE, remove_paa_pointer = 1:3, remove_paa_years = remove_paa_years1
)

## ============================================================
## 9) Fix Ecov random effects path for simulation:
##    - set historical Ecov_re (1:51) from fitted OM
##    - set future Ecov_re (52:57) = observed minus long-term mean (for projected)
##    - IMPORTANT: remove Ecov_re from random effects (TMB won’t re-simulate)
## ============================================================

## 9.1 Long-term mean (your explicit value)
long_term_bt_mean <- om_input_3[["par"]][["Ecov_process_pars"]][1]#7.341484

## 9.2 Populate Ecov_re into parameter list
## (length alignment: 1:51 is 1972–2022 when lag=1; 52:57 is 2023–2028)
om_input_3$par$Ecov_re[1:51, 1] <- Ecov_re[1:51, 1]             # from fitted OM/your saved RDS

## For PROJECTED scenario: future “random effect” = obs - process mean
om_input_3$par$Ecov_re[52:101, 1] <- om_input_3$data$Ecov_obs[52:101, 1] - long_term_bt_mean

## Tell WHAM to not simulate Ecov_re (use what we set)
om_input_3$data$do_simulate_Ecov_re <- 0L

## Remove "Ecov_re" from random effects so TMB won’t re-estimate/simulate it
if ("Ecov_re" %in% om_input_3$random) {
  om_input_3$random <- om_input_3$random[om_input_3$random != "Ecov_re"]
}

## ============================================================
## 10) Build UNFITTED OM object (TMB compiled), but do not fit
## ============================================================

unfitted_om_3 <- fit_wham(om_input_3, do.fit = FALSE, do.brps = FALSE, MakeADFun.silent = TRUE)

## Quick visual of Ecov obs vs latent x for this unfitted object
plot(unfitted_om_3$input$data$Ecov_obs, type = "l", col = "red",
     main = "PROJECTED scenario: Ecov obs vs latent",
     ylab = "Ecov", xlab = "row (1972..2028)")
lines(unfitted_om_3$rep$Ecov_x, type = "l", col = "blue")       # note: presence depends on model building; keep as per your script

## ============================================================
## 11) Simulate a concrete OM dataset from the unfitted OM
##     - We’ve removed Ecov_re from random list; keep others as-is
## ============================================================

random_3 <- unfitted_om_3$input$random
random_3 <- random_3[!random_3 %in% "Ecov_re"]                   # be explicit

set.seed(123 + 1L)
om_with_data_3 <- update_om_fn(unfitted_om_3, seed = 123 + 1L, random = random_3)

## Visual check again with simulated obs
plot(om_with_data_3$input$data$Ecov_obs, type = "l", col = "red",
     main = "Simulated OM: Ecov obs vs latent",
     ylab = "Ecov", xlab = "Year (1972..2072)")
lines(om_with_data_3$rep$Ecov_x, type = "l", col = "blue")
```

```{r LoopSetUp_1}
bt_temp <- om_with_data_1$input$data$Ecov_obs  # should be length 57 (1972–2028)

                      lag = 1,

## ============================================================

##     - mod2: EM uses HistAvg Ecov in projection period (2023–2028)
## ============================================================

## Harvest control rule used in both runs

## we reuse what we put into om_input_P (not input_P!)

  agg_index_sigma   = om_input_1$data$agg_index_sigma,
  index_Neff        = om_input_1$data$index_Neff,
  remove_agg        = TRUE,  remove_agg_pointer = 1:3, remove_agg_years = remove_agg_years1,
  remove_paa        = TRUE,  remove_paa_pointer = 1:3, remove_paa_years = remove_paa_years1
)

update_catch_info_list <- list(
  agg_catch_sigma = om_input_1$data$agg_catch_sigma,
  catch_Neff      = om_input_1$data$catch_Neff
)

## Common EM structural pieces (use same as OM to isolate Ecov differences)
M_em       <- M
sel_em     <- sel3
NAA_re_em  <- NAA_re
NAA_re_em$N1_model = "equilibrium" # IMPORTANT! Turn to equilibrium
age_comp_em <- "logistic-normal-pool0"
```

```{r LoopSetUp_2}

# base years are 1973:2022 (50 yrs), 6-yr feedback, lag=1
base.years <- 1973:2022
n_feedback <- 50
bt_temp <- om_with_data_2$input$data$Ecov_obs  # should be length 57 (1972–2028)

#scenarios <- create_ecov_scenarios(bt_temp, base.years, n_feedback, lag = 1)

ecov_opts <- list(use_ecov_em = TRUE,
                      lag = 1,
                      period = 51:101)

## ============================================================
## 13) Run two EM loops against the same OM:
##     - mod1: EM uses AR1 Ecov
##     - mod2: EM uses HistAvg Ecov in projection period (2023–2028)
## ============================================================

## Harvest control rule used in both runs
hcr <- list(hcr.type = 1, hcr.opts = list(use_FXSPR = TRUE, percentFXSPR = 75))

## For EM updates to index/catch info over full horizon,
## we reuse what we put into om_input_P (not input_P!)
update_index_info_list <- list(
  agg_index_sigma   = om_input_2$data$agg_index_sigma,
  index_Neff        = om_input_2$data$index_Neff,
  remove_agg        = TRUE,  remove_agg_pointer = 1:3, remove_agg_years = remove_agg_years1,
  remove_paa        = TRUE,  remove_paa_pointer = 1:3, remove_paa_years = remove_paa_years1
)

update_catch_info_list <- list(
  agg_catch_sigma = om_input_2$data$agg_catch_sigma,
  catch_Neff      = om_input_2$data$catch_Neff
)

## Common EM structural pieces (use same as OM to isolate Ecov differences)
M_em       <- M
sel_em     <- sel3
NAA_re_em  <- NAA_re
NAA_re_em$N1_model = "equilibrium" # IMPORTANT! Turn to equilibrium
age_comp_em <- "logistic-normal-pool0"

```

```{r LoopSetUp_3}
# base years are 1973:2022 (50 yrs), 6-yr feedback, lag=1
base.years <- 1973:2022
n_feedback <- 50
bt_temp <- om_with_data_3$input$data$Ecov_obs  # should be length 57 (1972–2028)

#scenarios <- create_ecov_scenarios(bt_temp, base.years, n_feedback, lag = 1)

ecov_opts <- list(use_ecov_em = TRUE,
                      lag = 1,
                      period = 51:101)

## ============================================================
## 13) Run two EM loops against the same OM:
##     - mod1: EM uses AR1 Ecov
##     - mod2: EM uses HistAvg Ecov in projection period (2023–2028)
## ============================================================

## Harvest control rule used in both runs
hcr <- list(hcr.type = 1, hcr.opts = list(use_FXSPR = TRUE, percentFXSPR = 75))

## For EM updates to index/catch info over full horizon,
## we reuse what we put into om_input_P (not input_P!)
update_index_info_list <- list(
  agg_index_sigma   = om_input_3$data$agg_index_sigma,
  index_Neff        = om_input_3$data$index_Neff,
  remove_agg        = TRUE,  remove_agg_pointer = 1:3, remove_agg_years = remove_agg_years1,
  remove_paa        = TRUE,  remove_paa_pointer = 1:3, remove_paa_years = remove_paa_years1
)

update_catch_info_list <- list(
  agg_catch_sigma = om_input_3$data$agg_catch_sigma,
  catch_Neff      = om_input_3$data$catch_Neff
)

## Common EM structural pieces (use same as OM to isolate Ecov differences)
M_em       <- M
sel_em     <- sel3
NAA_re_em  <- NAA_re
NAA_re_em$N1_model = "equilibrium" # IMPORTANT! Turn to equilibrium
age_comp_em <- "logistic-normal-pool0"
```

```{r sims}

model_nums <- 1:6
nsim <- c(1:10) # number of simulations/seed

# OM_1
mods <- lapply(nsim, function(r) {
  tryCatch({
  mod_list <- lapply(model_nums, function(m) {
    file_path <- file.path(sprintf(paste0(ModelLocations,"/OM_1/Mod.50yr_%d_%03d.RDS"), m, r))
    readRDS(file_path)
  })
  
  names(mod_list) <- paste0("Mod", model_nums)
  
  return(mod_list)
  }, error=function(e){})
})


saveRDS(mods, file = paste0(ModelLocations,"/OM_1/MSEmods_50yr.rds"))


#mods <- readRDS(paste0(ModelLocations,"/OM_1/MSEmods_50yr.rds"))

library(ggridges)
plot_mse_output(mods,
                main_dir = PlotLocations,
                output_dir = "/OM_1/Biases_Report_50yr",
                output_format = c("png"), # or html or png
                width = 10, height = 7, dpi = 300,
                col.opt = "D",
                new_model_names = c("Mod_AR1Ecov", "Mod_LOWEcov", "Mod_MEDLOWEcov", "Mod_MEDEcov", "Mod_HIGHEcov", "Mod_NoEcov"),
                base.model = "Mod_AR1Ecov",
                start.years = 51,
                use.n.years.first = 1,
                use.n.years.last = 3)
```
